title: Ironkeeper validation result
description: Machine-readable result of a document validation. Emitted by `ironkeeper report validate --json` and by the machine-readable form of any validation that reports a set of issues. Structural validity, semantic validity and the authenticity of the cited evidence are distinct concerns: this document reports on the document, never on the truth of what it asserts.

schema_version.description: Version of this validation contract. Only version 1 is implemented.

valid.description: True when the validated document satisfied both the structural and the semantic contract.

structural_valid.description: True when the validated document satisfied the structural contract. Absent when the structural check could not be completed.

semantic_valid.description: True when the validated document satisfied the semantic contract. Absent when the semantic check could not be completed.

issues.description: The issues that made the document invalid.

location.description: JSON Pointer into the validated document, when the issue refers to a specific position.

keyword_location.description: JSON Pointer to the keyword in the schema that produced the issue.
